dependency_advisory_evaluation.adoption_note: requirements.txt pins are the reproducibility contract; a pin change deserves its own deliberate step with a post-change full run. This evaluation is the evidence that such a step would not regress the suite.

windowed_reconciliation.closes: standing 'repeat-match robustness' blocker, recorded as reconciliation blocked on exact-set window semantics (Phase125 6 pre-window REST-only fills; Phase152 same class)
windowed_reconciliation.contract: in-window REST/socket sets must match exactly; every REST fill classified pre/in/post window and out-of-window ids reported, never dropped; status MATCHED_WINDOWED so it cannot be confused with the account-level certificate; window and classification bound by reconciliation_sha256
windowed_reconciliation.unit_trap: socket fills are venue microseconds, REST fills are milliseconds; the window is always milliseconds and an undeclared socket unit is refused, never guessed
not_a_relaxation: in-window REST fill missing from socket
windowed_reconciliation.tests: tests/test_private_fill_windowed_reconciliation.py (13 passed); module consumers 56 passed total, no regressions
windowed_reconciliation.honest_limit: certifies a window, not the account; out-of-window fills are classified but not reconciled
